title: mimi-mls: leaves advertise frank_aad 0x0020
description: Implement decision mimid-1wgh.4.52: identity.rs leaf app_data_dictionary safe_aad list = [0x0020 frank_aad, §7.5 GREASE]; app_components also lists 0x0020 (per DR-8 implemented components). Named constant with a doc saying it is a MIMI protocol-06 §5.4.1 component known to mimi-mls by decision. Update key_package_mls_rs.rs hand-encoded expected bytes (regression test first). Add a test: in a group requiring safe_aad [0x0020], a mimi-mls member's UpdatePath commit is accepted (it was refused before). Start after .4.48 lands (both edit mimi-mls).
